description: The company's plan and billable shipments for one month: included allowance, used, overage, cost so far and trial end. A shipment counts once per month when the carrier returned data for it. Use it for plan, quota or billing questions. Optional: month (YYYY-MM, UTC; default this month), include_shipments (default false) to list the counted shipments. Returns: month, plan, plan_name, included (null = unlimited), used, overage, projected_cost, currency, trial_ends_at, trial_active, and with include_shipments: shipments[] {shipment_id, reference, ref_type, first_counted_at, merged}.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

month.description: Calendar month YYYY-MM (UTC). Default: this month.
